units: <cite ref="Chullin 101b:6">Ḥull. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ הוא דהוה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. it was a time of persecution (when Jews were forbidden to observe their festive days), and they sent word from there (Palestine) that this year’s Day of Atonement should be observed on a Sabbath day.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> <he>הוו טמירין … ביומא דש׳</he> were hidden in a cave for thirteen years during the (Hadrianic) persecution; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8">Koh. R. to X, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:9">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> top <he>בשעת שׁוּמְדָּא</he>; a. e.
